hypotheses.rationale: Day 7 shows packing cubes at the entry hook at 20:57, strongly indicating preparation for another trip. This aligns with the Day 0-3 pattern (pack, leave, return, rest, pack again). The lack of laptop movement on Day 6 further weakens the WFH hypothesis.

Still possible if the person works remotely but travels frequently for leisure or side projects. However, the specific 'packing cubes' event is more indicative of travel than work. No laptop usage observed to support this.
The regularity of the trip (Mon-Sun cycle) makes 'occasional' less likely than 'regular business traveler'. No new evidence supports this over the primary hypothesis.

selected_evidence: Day 0, 19:59 — passport at bed_r1 (indicates travel planning)
Day 0, 20:44 — suitcase at entry_hook_e1 (confirms travel intent)
Day 3, 20:41 — laptop at desk_o1 (confirms work setup)
Day 7, 20:57 — packing_cubes at entry_hook_e1 (confirms preparation for next trip, repeating the cycle)
notes: The cycle appears to be: Pack/Leave Mon, Return Wed, Rest Thu-Sun, Pack Mon. Day 7 (Monday) evening packing cubes confirm the start of a new travel week. The laptop was seen on Day 3 but not Day 6; it may still be at the desk or packed away. Need to observe Day 8 (Tuesday) to see if the suitcase leaves again.
